3 وَاكبهُمْ (inf. n. مُوَاكَبَةٌ, TA,) He marched, or journeyed, or kept pace, with them; syn. سَايَرَهُمْ: or he hastened with them, and strove to be before them; syn. بَادَرَهُمْ: (K:) or he rode with them (S, K) in their مَوْكِب [or procession]: (TA:) and also, he contended with them in a race or the like. (S.) ―
-b2- See 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
